message.content:
An editorial illustration depicts two men seated in oversized, futuristic red and black swiveling chairs reminiscent of a talent show stage. Both men wear light-colored collared shirts and dark trousers. The man on the left sits with his legs crossed, resting his arm on a black console with a small red button. The man on the right sits upright, leaning forward onto a similar black console. Between them, a dark silhouette of a person stands in a bright, rectangular doorway at the top of a short flight of stairs. The background is dark, crisscrossed by a grid of glowing cyan lines and several out-of-focus yellow circular lights.

The top of the frame features large white text reading "TEMPO" above "SIAPA BAKAL JADI MENTERI". Smaller text includes "KETUA KPU: SAYA TAK TAKUT ANCAMAN" and "BABAK LANJUTAN SKANDAL LABEL HALAL". A barcode and price "RP 35.000" are located at the bottom left. The date "4-10 AGUSTUS 2014" is visible near the main title. The entire scene is enclosed within a thin red border.
